title: Open obligations on a run ended by cancel, supersede or detach are not offered as owed work
outcome: Open obligations on a run ended by cancel, supersede or detach are not offered as owed work
acceptance: A test shows that show, next and core inspect on an item whose run was ended by cancel, supersede or detach, while that run held an open obligation, give no owed-work guidance, reminder or open count for it, while the row stays readable as stored
The decision of which ended runs' obligations are history is made in the one place that decides it for completed and sealed runs, and is documented beside that rule
